lines: Humko dushman ki nigaahon se na dekha keeje
Humko dushman ki nigaahon se na dekha keeje
couplets.en: Do not look at us through the eyes of an enemy.

lines: Pyaar hi pyaar hain hum, pyaar hi pyaar hain hum, hum pe bharosa keeje
Humko dushman ki nigaahon se na dekha keeje
couplets.en: Trust us, for we are all love, and turn no enemy's gaze on us.

couplets.en: All you will come away with is a handful of memories.

lines: Chand yaadon ke siwa haath na kuchh aayega

couplets.en: Do not chase the fleeting years so, for they will leave you only a handful of memories.

couplets.en: If you cannot bear the light in another's courtyard, at least kindle some in your own home.
